notes.subject: בָּנֹה בָנִיתִי
notes.rationale: Infinitive absolute doubled with the verb — rendered doubled, 'Building I have built', not collapsed to 'I have surely built'

notes.subject: זְבֻל
notes.rationale: Rare word for an exalted residence, only here in Kings; also Isaiah 63:15, Habakkuk 3:11, Psalms 49:15

notes.subject: עוֹלָמִים
notes.rationale: Plural of 'concealed time / vanishing point'; intensive plural rendered 'forever', literal 'for eternities' lost

notes.subject: to YHWH
notes.rationale: Solomon addresses YHWH with a feminine suffix (לָךְ, לְשִׁבְתְּךָ)

translation: Building I have built a house of a dwelling-place for you, a firm place for your sitting, forever.
